name: anim_cru_morph2
subject: a thick pillar of pink and yellow marbled paint goo with a small black witch cat bound to it
desc: The goo pillar holding the bound cat bulges, swells and reshapes itself into a huge muscular pink paint crocodile monster with its arms stretched out like a cross and a mocking toothy grin, the cat stays pinned to its chest, thick goo stretching and dripping as the body forms.
